title: Shaul ben Bidri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Otzar Yisrael cites this name from [Menachot 35b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.35b.10), but Hyman says its author misread the text: it has Rabbi Shmuel bar Bidri. Dikdukei Soferim likewise has no such reading.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The misreading and absence of such a variant are Hyman’s judgments about Otzar Yisrael and Dikdukei Soferim, not a fresh comprehensive search.

The linked Bavli first gives Rav Shmuel bar Bidri transmitting in Rav’s name and then gives two alternative chains. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3382&lang=en) also records these attributions. Hyman gives Rabbi Shmuel. The judgments about Otzar Yisrael and Dikdukei Soferim are Hyman’s.
